# Student/postdoc information  
I can supervise students in epidemiology at both master and doctoral levels. Prospective students should contact me in advance of admission deadlines (program details [here](https://www.mcgill.ca/epi-biostat-occh/academic-programs/grad/epidemiology)) to assess suitability. All eligible students are strongly encouraged to apply for funding from the [*Canadian Institutes of Health Research*](http://www.cihr-irsc.gc.ca/e/193.html) and/or the [*Fonds de recherche du Québec - Santé*](http://www.frqs.gouv.qc.ca/en/) before solliciting admission at McGill.
